snippet.title: Worship | The One Who Summoned God - Full Release Trailer
snippet.description:
The Old Gods are calling; bring the end to us all!

Worship is officially out on Steam and PlayStation 5!

Convert followers to your world-ending cult in this Pikmin-inspired roguelike. Draw with blood to perform occult rituals, command a growing army of faithful and venture the world to corrupt it. The Old Ones have awakened and they await a vessel to prepare their arrival.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1548180/Worship/
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10018837
